subject.title: Feature Request: Add Anthropic native web search (web_search_20260209) as a search provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept an Anthropic-native hosted web-search provider as a first-class bundled provider, and if so should maintainers adopt the open fork PR or require a replacement implementation?
rationale: The feature adds provider/config/auth and hosted web-access behavior; current code lacks it, and the open linked PR is conflicting and not maintainer-modifiable, so automation should not choose the permanent product or security boundary.

options.title: Review or replace the linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide whether to adopt the open fork PR, request changes, or build a clean replacement in the Anthropic plugin boundary.

options.title: Defer to broader server-tools design
options.body: Fold the web-search request into the broader Anthropic server-tools design if maintainers want one architecture for web_search, web_fetch, and code_execution.

options.title: Reject bundled support for now
options.body: Close this and document the existing managed providers if maintainers decide Anthropic hosted search should not be bundled yet.

recommendation.title: Review or replace the linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide whether to adopt the open fork PR, request changes, or build a clean replacement in the Anthropic plugin boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest visible product-boundary context from Anthropic plugin/runtime work and prior review on the broader server-tools sibling.
